title: Japanese politicians, including the Defense Minister, visit Yasukuni Shrine on the anniversary of the end of the war
summary: Prime Minister Takaichi sent an offering, and senior members of the LDP and other parties visited the controversial shrine, which could strain relations with China and South Korea.

title: Tensions rise between the U.S. and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz as negotiations fail
summary: Two ships from the United Arab Emirates were attacked, and Trump threatened to consider the strait U.S. territory, as the 16th deadline for a deal approaches.

title: Torrential rains in Chiba cause flooding and the death of a man in an underpass
summary: A power outage left the drainage pumps of a below-grade road nonfunctional, while the area recorded record rainfall and alerts for convective rain lines.

title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Indonesia triggers tsunami alert in the region
summary: The quake off Indonesia posed no tsunami risk to Japan, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency.

title: Yen strengthens to the 159-yen-per-dollar zone on expectations of a BoJ rate hike
summary: The Japanese currency rebounded amid deteriorating U.S. indicators and reports of a possible monetary adjustment by the Bank of Japan.

title: New York's Dow Jones falls 107 points on weak economic data and Middle East uncertainty
summary: The U.S. stock index closed at 53,732 points, with declines tied to poor indicators and tensions in the Middle East.

title: Yokohama wins at Koshien with pitcher Oda's record 156 km/h
summary: Relief pitcher Oda surpassed the tournament's historical top speed and got the team out of a major jam with the bases loaded, driving the victory over Nichinan Gakuen.

title: Kasumigaura advances at Koshien with solid pitching and opposite-field hitting
summary: Starter Kobayashi pitched five innings with one earned run, and the team controlled Naruto Uzushio to seal their spot in the next round.

title: Police support sent to areas affected by the Kumamoto earthquake as tourism suffers cancellations
summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Police deployed an assistance team to shelters, and hotel cancellations in the prefecture exceeded 2 billion yen.

title: UK Reform Party leader wins re-election in a controversial by-election
summary: The vote was criticized as a sham over donation allegations and the absence of major parties in the contest.

title: Japan marks the 81st anniversary of the end of World War II with ceremony and political statements
summary: The national ceremony was held in memory of the fallen, with a record number of attendees born after the war, and parties issued messages on the occasion of August 15.

title: Daughters of soldiers killed in the war remember their fathers on the anniversary of the conflict's end
summary: An 87-year-old woman who waited five years for news of her father's death and another daughter who recalls her father, who died without becoming a station master, share their stories.
